canonical_project: Bundelkhand Data Centre Cluster (BIDA area) - proposed
owner: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Bundelkhand Industrial Development Authority (BIDA)
notes: On 21 May 2026 CM Yogi Adityanath directed officials to explore a major data centre cluster in the Bundelkhand Industrial Development Authority (BIDA) area as part of the Uttar Pradesh Data Centre Cluster (UPDCC) strategy. BIDA's operational area covers all seven Bundelkhand districts including Jalaun; no specific site or capacity has been allocated to any district yet. UP Data Centre Policy 2026 offers a 50% land subsidy in Bundelkhand; as of Jul 2026 no data centre has been built in the region. Regional/state-level proposal only.
